chapter: U Street, Jelly Roll Morton, the youth band and the WPA
title: Marrying Rhoda at seventeen and leaving high school
summary: Robert Harley's sister Rhoda, whom he first disliked, becomes his wife just after his seventeenth birthday.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: In the meantime, while I was playing up at this place, in the daytime I was always at my house playing. And this kid, Oswald Gibson, the saxophone player, had gone back in school... By this time I was out of school... Because I had met this fellow, Robert Harley, that I had known from the neighborhood in the earlier days, when he and I played piano... He had a sister, and her name was Rhoda. I had known her since I was... Well, actually I met him when I was about 13, and I had known her since she was about 12. And you know, like all young kids I didn't like her because she always seemed to be in the way, and I didn't particularly like her at all. Like, I didn't even care that much about girls then anyway, like most boys... Anyway, as fate would have it, a couple of years later she began to look different to me, which really wound up with him being my brother-in-law! Of course, she was my wife. And right after my seventeenth birthday was when I got married, and I fell out of high school.
